'''Alor-Wan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss]] [[Voss Mystics|Mystic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Alor-Wan had foreseen that the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] would destroy the Voss way of life; so when [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] arrived on [[Voss]], Alor-Wan send a Voss emissary named [[Sor-Nak]] to demanded that the Sith Lord turn back. The Sith Lord refused, so Sor-Nak left, stating that Alor-Wan had foreseen that they would not use force to dissuade Kallig. But nothing the Voss did stopped Kallig from a Voss mind-healing ritual to subdue four [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghosts]]. It is unknown how Alor-Wan's prophecy would affect the Voss.
